xbrli:xbrl.in-bse-shp:DisclosureOfNotesOnShareholdi:
1. Tata Steel Limited has acquired 100% stake of Tata Steel Colors Private Limited (Formerly Tata BlueScope Steel Private Limited), effective April 9, 2026.
2. Tata Steel Limited has acquired d 26% stake of TP Adarsh Limited, effective April 21, 2026 and accordingly, it is reported in the Shareholding Pattern for Q1 FY2026-27.
3. Crucible 2025 Ltd, a promotor group entity, was dissolved effective June 25, 2026, and hence, not reported under the Shareholding Pattern filled for Q1 FY2026-27.
4. 00224239 Limited, a promotor group entity, was restored by court order effective April 13, 2026, and thus the name is reflected in the filing for Q1 FY2026-27.
5. The name of Tata Steel Business Delivery Centre Limited, Subsidiary of Tata Steel Limited, was changed to Tata Steel Global Capability Centre Limited effective June 9, 2026, and hence, is reported under the new name in the Shareholding Pattern for Q1 FY2026-27.
6. Thriveni Pellets Private Limited was merged with Brahmani River Pellets Private Limited, a promotor group entity on May 21, 2026, and hence, not reported under the Shareholding Pattern filled for Q1 FY2026-27.
